digest: src/ has three TS files (workflow-stop.ts, workflow-cancellation.ts, workflow-terminal.ts) plus SPEC.md; no test files or test script exist, and store.js/types.js are absent from the excerpt.

implementationMap.observedBehavior: Default poll interval is 200ms (spec says 50ms) and the floor is 1ms (spec says not below 10ms). Interval cleared on dispose; no disposed flag.
Stop detected from disk intent via readWorkflowStopIntent or from registered launch AbortSignals for the same workflowRunPath key.

implementationMap.evidence: error.name = WORKFLOW_STOP_REQUESTED_ERROR_NAME; workflowStopRequestedMessage: `workflow stop requested for ${runId}`
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Error name is WorkflowStopRequested and message matches the spec format.
Also accepts any Error whose message starts with 'workflow stop requested'; spec says name-only.
Watch path swallows read errors; throwIfWorkflowStopRequested does not catch them, so they propagate.
bindWorkflowLaunchSignal returns an unregister function that removes the entry and deletes the map key when empty.

implementationMap.evidence: if (candidate === "aborted" || candidate === "AbortError" || candidate === "ABORT_ERR" || candidate === "cancelled" || candidate === "timeout") return true;
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Accepts 'cancelled' and 'timeout' in addition to the three spec strings; also honors value.cancelled===true and details.cancelled===true.

implementationMap.evidence:
const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(entry.text);
					if (parsed !== value && isWorkflowReturnedCancellation(parsed)) return true;
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Recurses into JSON text in content entries; each parse yields a fresh smaller-depth value so recursion terminates; applies same rule set.

implementationMap.evidence:
if (typeof DOMException !== "undefined" && value instanceof DOMException)
		return value.name === "AbortError";
implementationMap.observedBehavior: isWorkflowAbortError checks name 'AbortError' on DOMException or record values.
Completed run with degradation maps to completed_degraded; but direct-dynamic terminal runs overwrite semanticStatus afterward, so T1 is not guaranteed there.
Unreadable control.json becomes undefined; falls through to 'completed_without_semantic_result' unless an incomplete task or known status is present.
Summary exposes outputRetryAttempts (sums outputRetry.attempts) but names the launch sum 'launchRetries', not 'launchRetryAttempts' as the public contract requires.
No test script and no *.test.* or spec files exist in the repo excluding .agent-workflow; Q1 has no unit-test evidence.
